sloka: स राजा तेन वाक्येन प्रत्याश्वस्तो महामतिः ।प्रत्युवाच ततो वाक्यं दीनो भृत्यक्षयाद् भृशम् ।। ७.८९.१५ ॥
transliteration: sa rājā tena vākyena pratyāśvasto mahāmatiḥ ।pratyuvāca tato vākyaṁ dīno bhṛtyakṣayād bhṛśam ।। 7.89.15 ॥

translations.english: That great-minded king, though reassured by those words, then replied with great distress due to the loss of his servants.
